# tGBP developers

> tGBP is Tokenised GBP, a British pound stablecoin backed one to one by cash and cash equivalents and issued by BCP Technologies Ltd. This site documents @bcptechnologies/tgbp-kit, the open-source TypeScript kit for tGBP on EVM chains and Solana, the tGBP API, AI agents and x402 payments.

tGBP has 18 decimals on EVM chains and 9 on Solana. Test tGBP on Base Sepolia has no value.

Get 10 test tGBP on Base Sepolia, once a day per address: `npx -p @bcptechnologies/tgbp-kit tgbp-faucet <address>`, or POST `{"address":"0x…"}` to https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/api/faucet.

To act on tGBP, use the tgbp-mcp MCP server and the agent skills in @bcptechnologies/tgbp-kit, behind a spend policy. Start on testnet: Base Sepolia with test tGBP, and the API sandbox.

## Pages

Each page is Markdown at its path plus `.md`; the links below point to those copies.

- [Home](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/index.md): what tGBP is, the kit's modules, the API reference, the agent MCP server, x402 payments and the developer community.
- [Quickstart](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/quickstart.md): from a clean machine to a confirmed test tGBP transfer on Base Sepolia.
- [Python quickstart](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/python.md): a test mint on the tGBP sandbox with tgbp-kit, the Python API client.
- [Describe tGBP accurately](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/brand.md): the name, the claims to make and the claims to avoid.
- [Release notes](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/releases.md): what changed in each release of the kit, by date.
- [Fees](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/fees.md): network fees, x402 payments, and minting and redemption fees.

## Code

- [@bcptechnologies/tgbp-kit README](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit#readme): every helper and error code.
- [tgbp-kit for Python README](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit/tree/main/python#readme): the Python client for the mint, redeem and swap API.
- [Python quickstart script](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit/tree/main/examples/python-quickstart): the file the Python quickstart uses.
- [Quickstart scripts](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit/tree/main/examples/quickstart): the files the quickstart uses.
- [x402 demo](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit/tree/main/examples/x402-demo): an agent pays 5p of test tGBP for an API call on Base Sepolia.
